d: The DS-D2055EL-0A LCD display uses an industry-level extreme-narrow bezel design, which enables a bezel width of 1.7 mmbetween neighboring displays. The adopted direct-lit LED backlighting technology helps achieve ultra-high and uniformbrightness of 500 cd/m². The display has abundant interfaces for video inputs, such as DVI, VGA, HDMI, and DP.
